_comment: Frozen / legendary ranking snapshot for the HURDLE game. The page reads this file at load time and merges its 'rankings' array with the player's localStorage scores in the in-game ranking screen. To populate this with the legacy Firestore data, open Firebase Console -> Firestore -> 'ranking' collection -> export each document, then paste the rows into the rankings array below following the field schema in '_format'. Once the data is filled in, this file becomes the immutable 'legend' the local player competes against.

_format.name: string (display name, max ~24 chars)
_format.time: number (course time in seconds, smaller is better)
_format.hurdles: number (count of hurdle hits, smaller is better)
